title: Classic Banana Bread
ingredients:
3 ripe bananas
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp baking soda
1 1/2 cups flour
Pinch of salt
instructions:
Mash bananas and mix with butter.
Stir in sugar, egg and baking soda.
Fold in flour and salt.
Pour into a loaf pan and bake until a toothpick comes out clean.

title: Chewy Chocolate Chip Cookies
ingredients:
1 cup butter
3/4 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup sugar
2 eggs
2 1/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
2 cups chocolate chips
instructions:
Cream butter and sugars.
Beat in eggs.
Mix in dry ingredients, then chips.
Scoop onto trays and bake until edges are golden.

title: Lemon Drizzle Cake
ingredients:
200g butter
200g sugar
4 eggs
200g self-raising flour
Zest of 2 lemons
Juice of 2 lemons
100g icing sugar
instructions:
Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs.
Fold in flour and zest.
Bake in a lined tin.
Mix juice and icing sugar and pour over the warm cake.

title: Croissants
ingredients:
500g bread flour
10g salt
55g sugar
10g yeast
300ml cold milk
280g cold butter block
instructions:
Make the dough and chill overnight.
Enclose butter and complete three folds, chilling between each.
Roll, cut and shape triangles.
Proof, egg wash and bake.
